description:
You have now learned most of git. Kinda. You have learned at least 50% of git _you will actually use._ 60% of your workflow will end up being
- `git status`
- `git add`
- `git commit`
It's basically all you use as a solo dev. Another 5% is pushing to remotes (like github), another 35% is collaboration with other devs, and the final 10% is rolling back (somthing you hopefully never need to do)
